## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — code change, no behaviour change
- [ ] `chore` — config, deps, tooling
- [ ] `style` — CSS / UI only

## Target branch

- [ ] Merging into `dev` (staging) — normal feature work
- [ ] Merging into `main` (production) — promotion from `dev` after staging sign-off
- [ ] Merging into `main` (hotfix) — urgent prod fix

- [ ] No lint errors (`yarn lint`)
